The crown provides 1 armor and has no additional effect.

== Availability ==
Crafted with [[Dandelion]] x10 at a [[Workbench]] from {{#formatdate:1 Jun|dmy}} – {{#formatdate:6 Jul|dmy}} as part of the [[Seasonal Events|Midsummer]] event.
